title: Evaluator Startup Bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, and let $w,u$ be Boolean words and $T\in\mathbb N$. Suppose that $M$ computes output $u$ on input $w$ in time $T$. Then there are a saved configuration of $M$ on $w$ and a time $s\in\mathbb N$ with $s\le T+|w|+|u|+5$ such that the evaluator built over $M$, started on $w$ in its initial configuration, reaches after $s$ steps its canonical configuration at input position $0$, with certificate $u$ and head at $0$, in formula phase with formula bit true, clause bit false and skip flag cleared.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$M$ computes output $u$ on input $w$ in time $T$
replaced:
Let the extractor machine $M$ compute the certificate $u$ on input $w$ within $T$
steps. Then within $T + |w| + |u| + 5$ steps from its initial configuration, the
evaluator built over $M$ reaches the canonical evaluation configuration: some saved
bank of $M$, the certificate $u$ on the last tape with head at $0$, the input head
at $0$, formula phase with formula bit true, and empty output.
